notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has power 5 or greater and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler using Heroes' Bane's ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler equal to its power.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
